k_selection.rule: Training data only. Range 2-8 (existing K=3; upper end covers the six generator categories plus a failed-login mode without using labels). Rule fixed before running: among K with mean pairwise seed ARI >= 0.8 and every cluster >= 1% of training rows, take the highest mean input-space silhouette over 5 seeds; any K within 0.01 of the best -> the smallest such K. If no K qualifies, keep the existing K=3.
